{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Forsaken Skull''' was a quick enemy that appeared in [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a decently fast speed, slower than the [[Hex Minion]], but it had significantly more health than it. It also had [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]] by default, while also occasionally appearing with the [[Bloated]] and [[Nimble]] modifiers applied. ==Appearance== The '''Forsaken Skull''' was a large red skull that floated above the ground. This skull had a broken jaw and yellow glow inside its eyes. It also had two red arms, with two fingers on each. ==Strategy== *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Militant]], [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be used to kill this quickly. *The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be useful here, as it can kill multiple of them with its flames. *Due to its immunities, it is significantly harder to slow down. **Its [[Freeze Immunity]] prevents it from being frozen, chilled or have its defense dropped through freeze. **Its [[Stun Immunity]] makes it immune to knockback, while also only making it slowed down by stunning towers instead of being stunned. **The [[Toxic Gunner]], [[DJ Booth]]'s slowdown and [[Jester]]'s confusion are not affected by its immunities. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Trapper]] or [[Pyromancer]] can be used to drop its defense. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be used to drop its defense while also boosting your towers. **As it is immune to freeze, freeze defense dropping towers cannot be used to drop its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Forsaken Skull''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Hexscape Night 2 Cutscene 1|'''Forsaken Skull''' in the opening [[The Nightmare Realm]] cutscene. Hexscape Night 2 Cutscene 2|'''Forsaken Skull''' in the ending [[The Nightmare Realm]] cutscene. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Forsaken Skull's''' skull was based on the {{RLinkC|4765718|The Riddling Skull}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Forsaken Skull''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Forsaken Skull's''' defense. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Forsaken Skull''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Forsaken Skull's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Forsaken Skull''' removed. {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Hex Revenant]]|Wave 5|Forsaken Skull|Wave 6|[[Hex Mimic]]|Wave 7 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Hex Corpse]] & [[Hex Mimic]]|hardw3 = Wave 7 (Hard)}} {{Containment|[[Hex Corpse]]|Wave 6|Forsaken Skull|Wave 7|[[Hex Mimic]]|Wave 9}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
